chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman who said:

I recited in the presence of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) 'Dhawa Adlin minkum' (two just men among you), so he said: 'Dhu Adlin Minkum' (a just man among you). This is among that which the scribes made a mistake in.

key_terms.الْكِتَابُ: The Book (referring to the written codex/Mushaf)

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the Quranic text and the recitation of the Ahl al-Bayt regarding the number of witnesses for a bequest?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights a textual variant in the Quranic verse regarding witnesses for a bequest, where the Imam corrects the plural 'Dhawa' to the singular 'Dhu', indicating that the written copies (Mushaf) contained a scribal error.
